learning: The adjustments made are based on the telemetry data indicating line loss events and the robot's struggle to maintain its line.
notes: The controller has been designed to work with the updated geometry, focusing on improving line-following performance based on previous telemetry data.
rationale: The previous race telemetry indicated that the robot struggled with line loss events and did not complete the track. To improve performance, I have integrated a controller with a base speed of 0.5 m/s, proportional gain (kp) of 1.0, integral gain (ki) of 0.1, derivative gain (kd) of 0.01, and sensor weights of [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]. This configuration is expected to enhance line-following capabilities and reduce line loss events.
